messages:
auditor_jw: Hi @maria, quick ask from the SOC2 auditor: we need evidence mapping for controls related to KMS usage and RBAC changes covering the last 12 months. Specifically: sample KMS decrypt events tied to identities, RBAC change history with approvals, any emergency key access events and the post-incident review. We also need the retention policy proof and a short sampling justification.

maria (sec): Thanks. We can produce a packaged artifact set. Clarifying q: customer-data keys only or all platform keys? And preferred delivery method?

auditor_jw: Customer-data keys only. S3 pre-signed link is fine. Need the retention proof and a short writeup explaining the sampling approach so the auditor can reproduce the selection.

raj (infra): For KMS decrypt events we can pull CloudTrail where eventName=Decrypt and filter by KmsKeyId. We keep CloudTrail raw logs in S3 for 400 days and archive to Glacier for long term. Example lookup command we use: 

```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2024-03-01 --end-time 2025-03-01
```

raj (infra): We'll mask any customer ids in the sample artifacts before upload.

sam (sre): RBAC changes are in repo infra/rbac-configs. PRs are labeled rbac and require 2 approvals. We can export PR metadata and approval timelines from GitHub audit log and include the merged commit diffs. I can generate a CSV of PR, author, reviewers, timestamps.

maria (sec): Planned evidence bundle: 1) control mapping doc (control id -> artifact path + test performed) 2) 3 sampled CloudTrail JSONs for Decrypt events tied to customer-data keys (redacted) 3) GitHub PRs + approval comments 4) KMS rotation schedule and alias mapping 5) incident timeline and postmortem for any emergency key access 6) retention policy screenshot and S3 lifecycle config. We'll redact PII and customer ids.

auditor_jw: Also need to see the emergency access flow: where approvals are recorded, how keys are restricted post-event, and proof of rotation after emergency use. The post-incident review needs to show remediation and timelines.

raj (infra): Emergency access flow summary: requests go through PagerDuty incident with an approval step in Jira; runbook for privileged ops requires 2 approvers for elevated key actions. We log the runbook execution and CloudTrail shows GenerateDataKey or Decrypt events. Example event snippet (masked): 

{ user: arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:user/ops-oncall, eventName: Decrypt, kmsKeyId: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:REDACTED:key/abc-123, eventTime: 2025-01-15T18:22:03Z, requestParameters: { encryptionContext: { purpose: backup } } }

maria (sec): Sampling approach we propose: pick three 1-month windows across the 12 month period keyed to high-change periods (major releases), plus any month with an incident. For each window sample: 5 Decrypt events for customer-data keys tied to distinct principals, 3 PRs affecting RBAC with approval artifacts, and the lifecycle configs. We'll include rationale that this provides coverage of normal ops and high-change risk.

evidence-bot: Packaging job started for audit request 1951234567. Output target s3://redwood-compliance/audit-1951234567/ . ETA ~15m :package:

maria (sec): I'll assemble the control mapping spreadsheet and the sampling justification. Expected delivery: today EOD PST. @sam @raj please confirm you can produce GitHub exports and CloudTrail extracts by 15:00 PST.

sam (sre): can do.

raj (infra): can do, will scrub customer ids before upload.

evidence-bot: Upload complete. Pre-signed link: https://s3.aws/redwood-compliance/audit-1951234567/package.zip (expires in 7 days) :lock_with_ink_pen:

auditor_jw: Received the package, starting review. Thanks everyone, will follow up if we need more samples or clarifications.
